name: gigun
description: Plugins for Claude Code and Codex, including skills and development tools.

plugins.name: deepwiki-mcp
plugins.description: DeepWiki MCP server (GitHub repo docs Q&A)

plugins.name: markitdown-mcp
plugins.description: MarkItDown MCP server (file to markdown conversion)

plugins.name: agy-mcp
plugins.description: Antigravity CLI (agy) MCP server (Gemini: Google Search grounding, image/video understanding)

plugins.name: ios-skills
plugins.description: iOS app icon authoring, Simulator control, physical-device builds, and App Store Connect uploads.

plugins.name: todo
plugins.description: Durable repository context an agent reads: tasks in todo.txt (list what is ready, record every state change) and decisions in docs/adr (read what is decided, record new ones)

plugins.name: telemetry
plugins.description: Review Claude Code and Codex local sessions, or configured Langfuse traces, and identify evidence-backed improvements

plugins.name: t3
plugins.description: Delegate work to another provider or model as a T3 Code child task (t3-delegate), and check provider quota (t3-limits). Skills copied verbatim from ryoppippi/dotfiles and ryoppippi/t3-limits (MIT).

plugins.name: visual-explainer
plugins.description: Generate HTML diagrams, reviews, presentations and visual explanations.

plugins.name: ota-deploy
plugins.description: ASC-powered iOS builds and private Cloudflare or Tailscale OTA distribution with Bark notifications.

plugins.name: asc-mcp
plugins.description: Build a registered iOS app from a GitHub PR or commit through an authenticated remote MCP, inspect progress, and obtain a private install link.

plugins.name: swift-concurrency-pro
plugins.description: Reviews Swift code for concurrency correctness, modern API usage (actors, async/await), and common async pitfalls.

plugins.name: swift-testing-pro
plugins.description: Reviews Swift code for modern Swift Testing framework usage (@Test, #expect) and migration from XCTest.

plugins.name: swiftui-pro
plugins.description: Reviews SwiftUI code for modern API best practices, state management, and performance.

plugins.name: rea
plugins.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries: MCP server and skill (morluto/rea, MIT).
